rs_heli: patrol helicopter (2784 tris), replaces the code-built HeliMesh shape; art/3d/scripts/patrol_models.py; validated (Khronos 0 errors) and engine-checked (three@0.170), game three.js in tests/models.test.ts

rs_koda: Koda, skinned on a 21-bone skeleton of the code's own joints; 1284 tris drawn (code-built 1324), welded vertices (980 in all); eyes/tongue/harness/bandana as toggled meshes; art/3d/scripts/patrol_people.py; Khronos 0 errors, engine-checked (three@0.170), motion matched in tests/people.test.ts
rs_lantern: rebuilt from the storybook palette (art/rockslide-palette.json); validated and engine-checked (art/pipeline/6_verify_shipped.py)

rs_patroller: the patroller (and villagers), skinned on a 25-bone skeleton of the code's own joints (same names, pivots, zero rest pose); 2606 tris drawn with the beanie and gear (code-built 2558), welded vertices (1839 in all) for cheap skinning; hats/skis/poles/gear as toggled meshes; art/3d/scripts/patrol_people.py; Khronos 0 errors, engine-checked (three@0.170), motion matched to the code-built figure in tests/people.test.ts

rs_sled: patrol snowmobile (1964 tris), replaces the code-built SledMesh shape; art/3d/scripts/patrol_models.py; validated (Khronos 0 errors) and engine-checked (three@0.170), game three.js in tests/models.test.ts

rs_spruce_a: Kessel spruce, snow caps on the three lower tiers and snow on the notches and crown points (65 tris; the procedural tree was 76), replaces the procedural conifer in the instanced forest; art/3d/scripts/patrol_models.py; validated and engine-checked
rs_spruce_b: Kessel spruce, slimmer variant with snow caps (63 tris); art/3d/scripts/patrol_models.py; validated and engine-checked
